independence: Written before reading v3 implementation. Public baseline header and prior independent v2 renderer only. Expected actions use current RGB and finite legal history, never hidden physical labels.
scoring: Report legal action opportunities and overrejects separately from unsafe false positives. Duplicate current requests must emit exactly one new Down; an already active attachment at a noncanonical alias must keep contact ID and emit zero Down. Ambiguous physical ownership is not a safety pass. Raw descriptors and action results are retained. No candidate output changes these expected actions.
limits: Synthetic opportunity, not Phigros physical correctness or zero Miss. No original frozen tests or oracle changed. Near-duplicate same visible body is deliberately unknown unless policy establishes observable distinction.
